answer: Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 5 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the zenith check. Bindings are kept in glacier, verified in grove, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history thus fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. A farm of 1564 identities would post 2507 proofs and burn roughly 81 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
